title: Water Proof Helmet Cover
body_html:
Description:
Wear-resistant oxford fabric, with waterproof coating
Engraved seams, better protection against rain, water, snow, dust, etc.
Rain cover, adjustable by a tight rope,
Reflective effect, for better visibility and night light
Lightweight, foldable and easy to store,
